extension.description: Export Markdown to a real, editable .docx — Mermaid diagrams become native Word shapes, not flattened images.
command.exportDocument.title: md2nativedocx: Export document to Word
command.exportBlock.title: md2nativedocx: Export diagram under cursor
configuration.outputDirectory.markdownDe: Output folder for generated `.docx` files. Empty (default) = same folder as the source `.md` file — no configuration required before first use.
configuration.referenceDocument.markdown: Path to a `.docx` file used as the Word template for every export (mirrors Pandoc's `--reference-doc`) — point this at your company's template to match its fonts, colors, and styles. Empty (default) = the extension's built-in template. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder.
configuration.smartArt.enabled.markdownD: Off by default (a 2026-09-03 real-Word test found a diagram it produced would not open at all — see the compliance notes). When on, an eligible diagram (a simple chain, tree, or cycle shape) becomes a native, editable SmartArt graphic instead of the usual OOXML canvas shapes; treat as experimental until verified reliable in Word.
walkthrough.title: md2nativedocx — Mermaid diagrams to Word
walkthrough.description: Export your Mermaid diagrams as native, editable Word shapes — not flattened PNG images.
walkthrough.step1.title: Open a Markdown document
walkthrough.step1.description: Open or create a `.md` file containing a ` ```mermaid ` block.
walkthrough.step2.title: Click "⚙️ Export to Word"
walkthrough.step2.description: A link automatically appears above every detected mermaid block — no command to remember.
walkthrough.step3.title: Get your `.docx`
walkthrough.step3.description: A notification offers to open the file in Word or reveal it in the file explorer — shapes are individually selectable and editable.
